opening.argument: The materials present a free social-chat offering: “Chat Free Video Chat Chat Rooms Singles Chatting Apps,” alongside a direction to an external destination offering free video content: “Enter: https://www.freechatnow.net/ OR Get Free Video Clips For You!” The accompanying footage reinforces that presentation, visibly displaying “Free Chat Rooms” and “No registration needed” over people socializing, with the same “Free Chat Rooms” message over a crowded poolside scene. Nothing supplied requests payment, private credentials, investment participation, or a separate deceptive solicitation. The evidence therefore supports ordinary free chat, video chat, and singles-chat promotion without establishing a deceptive scheme.
